cooked: The regression test should cover both live gossip and replay from gossip_store; testing only the graph insertion path would miss the persistent-crash loop. A useful invariant here is that every accepted announcement remains safe to load after a restart, including records written by older versions. The fuzz target described seems well suited to preserving that property as the parser and graph code evolve.
